entities.name: Query KSR-family protein
observations: 768 aa, approximately 82.99 kDa; predicted near-neutral pI 7.39 and mildly hydrophilic composition.
Pfam detects SAM_KSR1_N at residues 33–86 and SAM_KSR1 at 92–166, supporting a KSR-family N-terminal sterile-alpha-motif region.
Pfam detects a C1_1 domain at residues 371–419, consistent with a cysteine-rich regulatory/phorbol-ester-like binding module.
Pfam detects overlapping PK_Tyr_Ser-Thr and Pkinase domains at residues 681–767, indicating a C-terminal protein kinase domain.
Long Ser/Pro-rich low-complexity segments likely provide phosphorylation-dependent regulation and docking sites.
No explicit catalytic reaction or sufficiently close annotation-transfer homolog was retrieved; exact paralog and substrate specificity remain uncertain.

entities.name: Ras-MAPK signaling
observations: The combination of KSR-family N-terminal SAM region, C1 domain, and C-terminal kinase domain is characteristic of kinase suppressor of Ras proteins that organize Raf-MEK-ERK signaling.
This pathway assignment is architecture-based and should be treated as a strong family-level inference rather than a directly retrieved curated annotation.

entities.name: Cytoplasm and plasma membrane
observations: KSR-family proteins are expected to function mainly as cytoplasmic signaling scaffolds, with regulated recruitment to membranes; this localization is inferred from family architecture and is not directly established by the sequence-only report.
